ctx.x: We sent for Kenny Clark to come out. Kenny Clark came out and joined the band, was a nice drummer. But we had a chance to get Big Sidney Catlett, who was a real great show drummer, not taking anything away from Kenny Clark, so we sent Kenny Clark back to Pittsburgh, and we hired Big Sidney Catlett.

And Big Sidney Catlett, in my opinion, was the greatest drummer ever lived. He could play a floor show so well that the chorus girls would go off and they would turn around and bow to Sidney Catlett. The chorus would bow to the audience and turn around and all of them walk in front of the bandstand and bow to Sidney Catlett, because he made them work. They'd feel so good out there working. He just make them just dance their hearts out. This man was a genius. And it makes a-- everytime I think of his playing, it…
